explanation: This unit tracks choosing a1: at GO it is 10 when the agent picks a1 (9 if the previous trial went unrewarded, 7-8 once a1 has lost several times in a row), and 0-1 when it picks a2 (3-5 on the first a2 choice right after a run of a1). At D2 it is always 0, and at D1 it is 0-1 after a rewarded trial or during an a2 run, but 3-7 after an unrewarded trial during an a1 run, rising with each additional loss in a row.
